Usage: musubix3 [options] [command]

Evidence-driven SDD for GitHub Copilot CLI / 根拠に基づく仕様駆動開発

Options:
  -V, --version                                    output the version number
  -h, --help                                       display help for command

Commands:
  init|install [options]                           Install repository skills and SDD artifacts (preserves existing files)
  upgrade [options]                                Refresh bundled skill files to match the installed musubix3 version; never touches config, constitution, or feature artifacts
  plugin-install [options]                         Delegate plugin installation to native copilot plugin install
  requirements                                     EARS requirement validation
  constitution                                     Versioned measurable policy validation
  design                                           Explicit design component validation and diagrams
  trace                                            Generated requirement/design/code/test traceability
  graph                                            Compiler-based imports, symbols, calls and architecture
  knowledge                                        Local artifact and Git evidence retrieval (TF-IDF, not GraphRAG)
  formal                                           Honest consistency checking of an explicit abstraction
  gate [options]                                   Run actual configured commands and deterministic SDD checks
  config                                           Inspect and validate .musubix/config.json
  evidence                                         Refresh derived evidence in deterministic gate order
  mutation                                         Inspect and validate requirement-scoped mutation evidence
  model-correspondence                             Validate formal-model to authoritative passing-test correspondence
  workflow-record [options] <skill> <phase>        Record a self-reported workflow declaration
  workflow-verify [options] <log...>               Reconcile workflow declarations with Copilot JSONL Skill events
  workflow-sanitize [options] <log> <output-file>  Write a privacy-minimized Skill lifecycle transcript
  workflow                                         Workflow reconciliation waiver evidence
  attestation                                      Create and verify static-key or GitHub OIDC-authorized Ed25519 attestations
  change-record [options] <change-id> <phase>      Record an ordered staged-change fingerprint checkpoint; rejects an unchanged fingerprint since the preceding phase. Each recorded phase/batch stores both order (the verified, gate-checked logical append sequence from order.json — the only field guaranteed correct and monotonic per change) and recordedAt (an independently captured wall-clock timestamp with no ordering guarantee; gate reports it via CHANGE_RECORDEDAT_OUT_OF_ORDER, a non-blocking warning, when it disagrees with order)
  change                                           Change chronology and waiver evidence
  approval                                         Prepare, record and validate explicit artifact-bound human approvals
  tdd                                              Verified Red-Green-Refactor execution evidence. <test-id> requires two independent things: a trace-graph @id/@verifies doc comment above the test (for requirement linking), and a matching native adapter report entry (adapter-specific: title substring for vitest/jest/pytest, name suffix for go-test/cargo, an additional @Tag for junit, DisplayName for dotnet). See README.md "Adapter test-ID declaration reference" for the full table and worked examples.
  status [options]                                 One-shot artifact and gate readiness summary
  help [command]                                   display help for command

Usage: musubix3 change-record [options] <change-id> <phase>

Record an ordered staged-change fingerprint checkpoint; rejects an unchanged
fingerprint since the preceding phase. Each recorded phase/batch stores both
order (the verified, gate-checked logical append sequence from order.json — the
only field guaranteed correct and monotonic per change) and recordedAt (an
independently captured wall-clock timestamp with no ordering guarantee; gate
reports it via CHANGE_RECORDEDAT_OUT_OF_ORDER, a non-blocking warning, when it
disagrees with order)

                          (defect fixes only)

Usage: musubix3 tdd [options] [command]

Verified Red-Green-Refactor execution evidence. <test-id> requires two
independent things: a trace-graph @id/@verifies doc comment above the test (for
requirement linking), and a matching native adapter report entry
(adapter-specific: title substring for vitest/jest/pytest, name suffix for
go-test/cargo, an additional @Tag for junit, DisplayName for dotnet). See
README.md "Adapter test-ID declaration reference" for the full table and worked
examples.

Options:
  -h, --help                    display help for command

Commands:
  validate [options]
  red [options] <test-id>       Record a failing (Red) test as TDD evidence for
                                a requirement. Persisting the project's first
                                cycle here makes gate's tdd check required
                                project-wide for every mandatory requirement
                                (each uncovered one surfaced as
                                TDD_REQUIREMENT_UNCOVERED); "approval record
                                release" always runs the full (non-'--changed')
                                gate, so it is blocked by any resulting
                                TDD_REQUIREMENT_UNCOVERED diagnostics. "tdd
                                migrate" cannot bulk-onboard
                                previously-uncovered requirements: it only
                                re-fingerprints a requirement that already has a
                                valid Green cycle.
  green [options] <test-id>
  refactor [options] <test-id>
  migrate [options] <test-id>
  void [options] <test-id>
  help [command]                display help for command

Usage: musubix3 tdd red [options] <test-id>

Record a failing (Red) test as TDD evidence for a requirement. Persisting the
project's first cycle here makes gate's tdd check required project-wide for
every mandatory requirement (each uncovered one surfaced as
TDD_REQUIREMENT_UNCOVERED); "approval record release" always runs the full
(non-'--changed') gate, so it is blocked by any resulting
TDD_REQUIREMENT_UNCOVERED diagnostics. "tdd migrate" cannot bulk-onboard
previously-uncovered requirements: it only re-fingerprints a requirement that
already has a valid Green cycle.

Options:
  --root <directory>  Project root / プロジェクトルート (default: ".")
  --json              Machine-readable JSON
  --requirement <id>  Requirement ID verified by the test
  --command <name>    Configured command name to execute
  -h, --help          display help for command

  trace                                            Generated requirement/design/code/test traceability
  graph                                            Compiler-based imports, symbols, calls and architecture
  knowledge                                        Local artifact and Git evidence retrieval (TF-IDF, not GraphRAG)
  formal                                           Honest consistency checking of an explicit abstraction
  gate [options]                                   Run actual configured commands and deterministic SDD checks
  config                                           Inspect and validate .musubix/config.json
  evidence                                         Refresh derived evidence in deterministic gate order
  mutation                                         Inspect and validate requirement-scoped mutation evidence
  model-correspondence                             Validate formal-model to authoritative passing-test correspondence
  workflow-record [options] <skill> <phase>        Record a self-reported workflow declaration
  workflow-verify [options] <log...>               Reconcile workflow declarations with Copilot JSONL Skill events
  workflow-sanitize [options] <log> <output-file>  Write a privacy-minimized Skill lifecycle transcript
  workflow                                         Workflow reconciliation waiver evidence
  attestation                                      Create and verify static-key or GitHub OIDC-authorized Ed25519 attestations
  change-record [options] <change-id> <phase>      Record an ordered staged-change fingerprint checkpoint; rejects an unchanged fingerprint since the preceding phase. Each recorded phase/batch stores both order (the verified, gate-checked logical append sequence from order.json — the only field guaranteed correct and monotonic per change) and recordedAt (an independently captured wall-clock timestamp with no ordering guarantee; gate reports it via CHANGE_RECORDEDAT_OUT_OF_ORDER, a non-blocking warning, when it disagrees with order)
  change                                           Change chronology and waiver evidence
  approval                                         Prepare, record and validate explicit artifact-bound human approvals
  tdd                                              Verified Red-Green-Refactor execution evidence. <test-id> requires two independent things: a trace-graph @id/@verifies doc comment above the test (for requirement linking), and a matching native adapter report entry (adapter-specific: title substring for vitest/jest/pytest, name suffix for go-test/cargo, an additional @Tag for junit, DisplayName for dotnet). See README.md "Adapter test-ID declaration reference" for the full table and worked examples.
  status [options]                                 One-shot artifact and gate readiness summary
  help [command]                                   display help for command
